description: A donut whose slices are pulled apart with wide gaps and rounded corners.
overview: A donut whose slices are pushed apart with wide gaps and rounded corners, giving each segment a tile-like look. Choose it for a softer, more decorative style than the standard donut.
usage: Replace `chartData` and add each category to `chartConfig`. Tune the spacing with `paddingAngle` and the rounding with `cornerRadius`; large values for either make small slices hard to see.
notes: The wide gaps and rounded corners squeeze very thin slices, so this style suits data without tiny values.
